videos.title: Fast and Slow Opposites for Kids | Sunny Hill Ep 14 Tiko & Pip
videos.hook_premise: Tiko wants the picnic flag on top of the hill, and the child's word, fast or slow, sets how each helper gets it there so everyone arrives together.
videos.story_structure: help-the-character (ribbon track to the flag: the child's word, fast or slow, sets how each helper moves)

videos.hook_premise: Where does Pip live? A sleepy cow, duck and hen each need their home, and the child picks the door until the last home is Pip's hidden nest.
videos.story_structure: help-the-character (Sunny Hill, only structure; round game with a child shout per round)

videos.title: Brush Your Teeth Song for Toddlers | Sunny Hill Ep 6 with Tiko & Pip
videos.hook_premise: Can we make the horse's sticky-jam smile sparkle? One giant brush, four hiding spots, and the child's own brush circles.
videos.story_structure: help-the-character (Brush-Along Zones: do-along body routine with a rhythm refrain)
videos.story_spine: The horse wants a sparkly smile for the hilltop photo, but the sticky jam spots hide in different places and Tiko tries to rush it with 'All done!', therefore the child tells him to go slow and they brush slowly, zone by zone in small circles (top, bottom, front, back), until every spot sparkles.
